text: Pellet, ɓen yiɗuɓe yo pankare ɗe lollu e hoore gomɗinɓe ɓen -no jeyaa e majji tukkirgol jeeno ngon- no woodani ɓe Lepte muusuɗe ka aduna sabu ñimnugol hiddi tukkugol e dow maɓɓe, no woodani ɓe kadi ka Laakara Lepte Yiite, Alla no Anndi penaale maɓɓe ɗen, e ko fiyakuuji jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen wontata, hiMo Anndi kadi nafaaji maɓɓe ɗin, onon on anndah ɗum.
